label: RIPng
notes: RIP next generation over UDP port 521, the IPv6 counterpart of RIP (the two share the 4-byte header layout). Only that fixed header is modelled: Command, Version and the must-be-zero word. Route Table Entries are variable-count 20-byte chains (IPv6 prefix, route tag, prefix length, metric), and the first RTE of a datagram may instead be a next-hop RTE (RFC 2080 section 2.1.1), so no byte past the header sits at a trustworthy fixed offset.

fields.label: Must be Zero
fields.description: Unused; senders set it to zero, receivers must not rely on it.
